patterndesk-desk-1.alt: The Desk tab: three market cards for India, the UK and the USA, each with a Stand aside stance, the latest close, a signal score bar, and Long if, Short if and Wait if closing levels with targets.
patterndesk-desk-1.caption: The Desk: one card per market, with the stance, the score and the closing levels that would change it.

patterndesk-india-sessions-1.alt: The India tab: session cards with today in the middle, a past card with the Nifty close, the move, the reason, an Anomaly line and the signal, and cards for the sessions ahead.
patterndesk-india-sessions-1.caption: The seven-day strip from version 1 is still there: past sessions on the left, today in the middle, events ahead on the right.

patterndesk-india-plan-1.alt: The India plan for the Nifty 50: a Stand aside stance, a two-sentence reason, three paths with odds of 40%, 35% and 25%, each with a closing trigger, a target and an exit, and a signal score of +24.
patterndesk-india-plan-1.caption: The India plan after the rebuild: a stance, three paths with odds, and the score that sits behind them.

patterndesk-backtest-1.alt: A table titled What has worked on these bars: each signal with its direction, a hit-rate bar, the rate, the number of cases, the last 10 results, the average next move and the date last seen.
patterndesk-backtest-1.caption: Every signal, scored against the bar that came next. Green is above 55%, red is below 45%.

patterndesk-prices-1.alt: Prices now: live tiles for the Nifty fund, the India fund, the rupee, the UK fund and the pound, and world tiles for Brent, the US 10-year yield, Fed hike odds, gold and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 funds, each with its date.
patterndesk-prices-1.caption: A green dot means live. Every other value shows the date of the refresh it came from.

patterndesk-usa-plan-1.alt: The USA plan for the S&P 500: three paths with odds of 35%, 40% and 25%, each written as If close above or below a level, with a target and an exit, and a note that triggers use the daily close.
patterndesk-usa-plan-1.caption: Each path is a test: if this close happens, here is the target, and here is the close that ends it.

patterndesk-uk-plan-1.alt: The UK plan for the FTSE 100: a Stand aside stance, three paths with odds of 30%, 40% and 30%, and a signal score of -29 that leans short.
patterndesk-uk-plan-1.caption: The UK score leans short at -29, but the stance stays Stand aside: no close has broken the trigger yet.

patterndesk-usa-sessions-1.alt: USA session cards: a past card for Mon 23 Nov with the S&P 500 close, the reason for the move and an Anomaly line, today's card with scheduled events, and cards ahead.
patterndesk-usa-sessions-1.caption: The Anomaly line names a move the signals did not predict, so surprises stay visible.

patterndesk-setups-1.alt: Top 5 setups this week: three setup cards for the Nasdaq 100, GBP/USD and Brent crude, each with a direction, conviction, a short reason, Act if and Cancel if tests, dates and a source, and a count of 3 worked of 15 graded setups.
patterndesk-setups-1.caption: The weekly top 5, each with an Act if test and a Cancel if test. The running record sits in the corner.

patterndesk-chart-1.alt: Nifty 50 daily candles with the 9 and 21 EMA, pattern triangles, open gap bands, Fibonacci levels, a Next column of pivot and CPR lines, and volume and RSI 14 panels below.
patterndesk-chart-1.caption: Nine instruments, five timeframes, and five layers you can switch on and off. The grey Next column holds the lines for the next session.
